qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extreme switching costs driven by FDA/GMP regulatory validation lock-in where MTD precision instruments, calibration protocols, and SOPs are embedded in certified drug manufacturing, QA/QC workflows, and laboratory environments. Proprietary SternDrive pricing program systematically realizes 200-400 bps of annual price increases with near-zero churn, sustaining ~59% gross margins and >50% GAAP ROIC. Primary erosion threats are low-end industrial weighing commoditization and geopolitical trade tensions in China.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Dominant precision weighing and analytical instrument compounder with insurmountable GMP calibration lock-in and high-margin proprietary consumables. Exemplary Outsider capital allocation returning virtually 100% of FCF via share repurchases with 16x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: organic volume 3.0% + pricing 2.0% + mix & automation 0.5% + margin expansion 0.5% + share repurchases 2.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 51.4% and operating ROIC >100%. Free cash flow conversion consistently ~100% (FY2025 Owner FCF $853.6M on $869.2M NI; capex is just ~2.7% of sales). Peak-to-peak Owner EPS compounded from $38.41 in FY2022 to new record $42.05 in FY2025 despite temporary China post-COVID destocking. Net debt / NI of 2.33x with 16.3x EBIT interest coverage.
